pages.text: Every strange dimension has the item that lets you survive it. Each one was made from what you brought back from the places before it - so it carries their protection too.$(br2)Carry an attunement item and every dimension whose own item comes $(l)earlier$() in this list cannot touch you at all: no debuffs, no strange gravity, no rules.
$(li)$(item)Form of the Self$(): the Platonic Realm$(li)$(item)Penning Harness$(): the Antiverse$(li)$(item)Coherence Stabiliser$(): the Quantum Foam$(li)$(item)Brane Tether$(): the Bulk

$(li)$(item)Geodesic Anchor$(): black and white holes$(li)$(item)Well-Ordering Charm$(): the Transfinite Hierarchy$(li)$(item)Primordial Charter$(): Hyperdimensional Reality$(li)$(item)Identity Kernel$(): the Transcendental$(br2)So the $(item)Primordial Charter$() shields you completely in every place before Hyperdimensional Reality, does its usual job inside Hyperdimensional Reality itself, and only the Transcendental still needs the $(item)Identity Kernel$(). In its own dimension, each item works as it always has.
